entities.summary: Hibiki  was the twenty-second of twenty-four Fubuki-class destroyers, or the second of the Akatsuki class, built for the Imperial Japanese Navy in the inter-war period. Hibiki was among the few destroyers to survive the war. In 1947; two years after she was struck from the Japanese navy list, Hibiki was transferred to the Soviet Navy as a war reparation, and was later sunk as a target ship sometime in the 1970s.
